Welcome Prospective Students & Parents
At PGP College of Agricultural Sciences (PGPCAS), we welcome aspiring students who are passionate about agriculture and committed to building a sustainable future. Our admission process ensures transparency, fairness, and alignment with Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) norms.
We are affiliated to TNAU, Coimbatore, and most of our admissions are conducted through their centralized counseling system. However, we also offer limited Management Quota seats, which are handled directly at our Principal’s office.
TNAU Admission 2026-27 (UG & Diploma)
SUBMISSION OF ONLINE APPLICATION to TNAU is MANDATORY
for getting admission in constituent and affiliated colleges through
counselling and management quota.

Admission Procedure
PGPCAS offers admissions to both B.Sc. (Agri) and Diploma (Agri) programs through the following channels:
TNAU Single Window System (65% of seats)
Eligibility: As prescribed by TNAU for respective courses.
Application: Candidates must apply through the TNAU Online Admission Portal during the admission cycle.
Counseling: Conducted centrally by TNAU.
Seat Allocation: Based on merit, rank, and student preferences.
Enrollment: Allotted candidates must report to PGPCAS with the necessary documents for admission formalities.
Management Quota (35% of seats)
Eligibility: As prescribed by TNAU for respective courses.
Application Requirement: Online application through TNAU portal is compulsory, even for management quota admissions.
Admission Process:
Candidates must apply online through TNAU.
After registering, students seeking admission under Management Quota should contact the college directly.
Selection is based on merit and as per
TNAU/University norms
.
Seat confirmation and admission formalities will be completed at the college.
